inputs.text:
Folks, they want us to believe that wanting secure elections is somehow a threat to our institutions. Look at what they are doing to people who are simply trying to expose the flaws in our voting systems. Harry Wait, who leads a group spreading false election claims, was put through a trial where a Racine County jury on Tuesday found him guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge following a two-day trial, though he was thankfully acquitted of a second count of identity theft. 

Why did he do it? In 2022, he requested the ballots of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent, and he admitted he did this to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud. 

Instead of fixing a broken system and protecting basic security and order, the establishment goes after the citizen while protecting the elites like Robin Vos and Cory Mason. This is about silencing those who demand accountability and respect for our traditions, while the real bad actors try to exploit the system with impunity.
